correctness.rationale: From two equiprobable affine states, perceived route-cost gap is F_gamma(y)=u+H/2-c-d+(v+d)y+gamma(H-Delta*y)^2/4, with positive second derivative. The two strict endpoint Wardrop inequalities give the exact open intercept interval of width gamma Delta(2H-Delta)/4-(v+d); since the interval lower bound is positive, the gamma threshold is necessary and sufficient. Convexity and F(0)>0>F(1) force a single interior root with negative slope and the stated projected-adjustment repulsion. For the given rational roads, independent polynomial expansion, discriminant, root counts and exact boundary factorizations at 11/10,7/5,45/32 confirm all seven equilibrium regimes including weak/double-root cases. The exact symbolic argument, not finite parameter tests, covers all admissible parameters.
